content: The top-secret Premium Warbond that no one saw coming: Ironclad Democracy. Send shockwaves of Freedom tearing across the battlefield. Spearhead an unstoppable armored advance with ground-shaking heavy ordnance to crush anti-Democratic ideology beneath the Tracks of Justice. No detours, no deviations. The shortest distance between tyranny and Liberty is one straight, explosive line. Take the direct route to Freedom and become the stuff of Super Earth legend – in story, song and glorious memorial services. The Ironclad Democracy Warbond* is deploying to your Destroyer’s Acquisitions Panel loaded with weapons, armor and gear for today, tomorrow and all your days of loyal service. Available September 22, 2026. *Requires base game, Super Credits, and game progression to unlock.
